reason: I have one apartment and I answer my guests myself, even at night. That is how we do hospitality here, and €120 is real money from what I earn when the questions are things I already put in my welcome message.
objection: My guests like talking to me personally, not to a robot. If they get a machine first, they will think I don't care, and the reviews come from that personal touch.
would_change_my_mind: If another host with one apartment I know showed me guests still left warm reviews and it really stopped the 2 a.m. Wi-Fi and parking messages, and it cost less, maybe €50 for the season.
